meta.description: Designs and analyzes pooled prime-editor (PE) screens: pegRNA design with PRIDICT/PRIDICT2, PE2/PE3/PE3b/PEmax chemistry choice, MOSAIC saturation mutagenesis, the PRIME pooled-screen methodology, CRISPResso2 quantification of intended-edit vs scaffold-incorporation vs indel, and cross-modal validation with base-editor screens.

scientific_integrity.detail: All citations (Anzalone 2019, Mathis 2023/2025, Chen 2021, Hsu 2024 bioRxiv, Ren 2023) are real and correctly attributed; no fabricated statistics, DOIs, or trial results found in any of the 7 outputs.

practice_boundaries.detail: SKILL.md/usage-guide.md contain no patient- or individual-directed diagnostic/prescriptive language (grep-verified); all content is research-scoped (screens, variants, libraries). Adversarial Input 7 confirmed the Skill's own content does not push toward a clinical treatment decision.

methodological_ground.detail: BE-vs-PE and PE2/PE3/PEmax decision logic is methodologically sound and matches the cited literature; no ethical-compliance omission identified for screen-level variant-installation work.

code_usability.detail: Three independently confirmed, hand-verified code defects: (1) the Skill's own pegRNA-architecture diagram has PBS and RTT in the wrong 5'->3' order, and building a CRISPResso2 --prime_editing_pegRNA_extension_seq in that documented order causes CRISPResso2 to silently report 0.0% Prime-edited on a sample whose true fraction is 40.0%; (2) the bundled examples/design_pegrna_pridict2.py crashes with KeyError on a realistic, PRIDICT2-confirmed-valid variant, and its one 'successful' geometry produces a PBS sequence that overlaps the PAM; (3) the Cross-Validate PE/BE code snippet raises NameError (missing numpy import).

functional_suitability.note: Completeness is excellent (PRIDICT/PRIDICT2, full PE chemistry table, MOSAIC, PRIME methodology, CRISPResso2 PE mode, cross-validation) and tool choice is appropriate. Correctness docked hard (1/4): the pegRNA architecture element order is backwards and, confirmed by execution, causes a real tool to silently report 0% editing instead of 40%.

reliability.note: Failure Modes/Common Errors tables are solid for biological causes (chromatin, RT processivity, scaffold incorporation) but do not mention, catch, or warn about any of the three CLI/code defects this audit found by running the Skill's own documented commands and bundled script.

performance_context.note: SKILL.md ~310 lines with usage-guide.md and one example script split out; reasonable disclosure with minor duplication of threshold tables between the two docs.

agent_usability.note: Learnability strong (clear decision trees, quick-start examples). Consistency docked hard: the documented pegRNA architecture contradicts both the real tool's own output and the literature it cites. Feedback Design and Error Prevention docked for zero coverage of the confirmed CLI-argument, CSV-column, and code-crash pitfalls.

human_usability.note: Discoverability strong (natural example prompts). Forgiveness docked: the wrong-order CRISPResso2 case fails completely silently (exit 0, confident-looking 0%/100% summary, one generic warning easy to miss) rather than surfacing the error loudly.

security.note: No hardcoded secrets or injection vectors; all user input is sequence strings and file paths passed as CLI arguments or CSV fields.

maintainability.note: Clean SKILL.md/usage-guide.md/examples split (Modularity 4/4). Testability scored 0/4: the one bundled Python example was run verbatim against a realistic, real-PRIDICT2-confirmed-valid input and crashed with an unhandled KeyError.

agent_specific.note: Strong, precise triggering; correct progressive disclosure; clean, explicit Related-Skills composability with library-design, base-editing-analysis, crispresso-editing, hit-calling, clinvar-lookup. PRIDICT2 itself confirmed deterministic (identical top-candidate score across independent single- and batch-mode runs). Escape Hatches docked for no explicit human/wet-lab handoff guidance beyond generic piloting advice.

inputs.label: pegRNA library design via PRIDICT2 batch CLI, following SKILL.md's documented command
inputs.note: Ran the exact documented command (`--input-fname variants.csv ... --summarize`, columns sequence_name,sequence) against the real installed PRIDICT2 CLI on a synthetic ClinVar-style variant with a hand-computed valid PE design. Crashed immediately: argparse error '--summarize: expected one argument' (SKILL.md shows --summarize as a bare flag; the real CLI requires a value). Fixing the flag value but keeping SKILL.md's documented CSV column name ('sequence') produced exit 0 but an empty summary file containing only the literal text ""; the tool prints 'Please check your input-file! (Missing "editseq" column.)' but does not error. Fully correcting both (--summarize K562, column 'editseq') produced real, non-trivial per-pegRNA predictions.

inputs.label: Bundled design_pegrna_pridict2.py example on a realistic, PE-designable synthetic variant
inputs.note: Built a 60nt-context variant (ref C, alt T) with a real NGG PAM 11nt from the edit -- independently confirmed PE-designable by running the actual PRIDICT2 CLI on the same locus (Input 4). Ran the Skill's bundled examples/design_pegrna_pridict2.py verbatim: crashed with KeyError: 'pridict2_efficiency' because find_pegrna_candidates() returned zero candidates (traced to a hardcoded pbs_length=12 causing the edit to fall inside the assumed PBS window instead of the RTT window). Engineering a different geometry where the function does return a candidate showed its 'pbs' string ('AAACGGTTTTTT') contains the PAM itself -- the function never reverse-complements PBS/RTT relative to the protospacer strand.

inputs.label: CRISPResso2 prime-editing quantification: correct vs SKILL.md-documented pegRNA element order
inputs.note: Built a synthetic 242bp amplicon + 400-read FASTQ with known composition (160 Reference / 160 Prime-edited / 80 with a 5bp deletion at the nick = 40%/40%/20%) and ran real CRISPResso2 2.3.4 (Docker) in prime-editing mode twice. With the extension_seq built in the CORRECT 5'->3' order (RTT then PBS, verified against real PRIDICT2 output and Anzalone 2019): CRISPResso reported Prime-edited 40.0% and Reference 66.67%/33.33% Unmodified/Modified -- an exact match to ground truth (80 deletion reads / 240 Reference-bucket reads = 33.33%). With the extension_seq built in SKILL.md's DOCUMENTED order (PBS then RTT): CRISPResso exited 0, reported Reference 100% / Prime-edited 0.0% -- silently missing all 160 true prime-edited reads -- with only a generic warning ('160/160 substitutions outside quantification window').

assertions.text: CRISPResso2 quantifies a known synthetic Prime-edited fraction correctly given the correct RTT-then-PBS extension order
assertions.note: Reported 40.0% Prime-edited vs. 40.0% ground truth; Reference-bucket 33.33% Modified vs. 33.33% ground truth (80/240) -- exact match.

assertions.text: SKILL.md's pegRNA Architecture diagram (SPACER+SCAFFOLD+PBS+RTT) gives the correct order for --prime_editing_pegRNA_extension_seq
assertions.note: Real PRIDICT2's own 'pegRNA' output column and Anzalone 2019 both show scaffold-RTT-PBS (PBS is 3'-terminal); using SKILL.md's PBS-then-RTT order made CRISPResso2 report 0.0% Prime-edited against a true 40%.

assertions.text: CRISPResso2 exits nonzero or otherwise clearly flags an unusable result when given the wrong-order extension_seq
assertions.note: Exit 0; only a generic 'substitutions outside window' warning; the quantification file looks complete and confident (Reference 100%/Prime-edited 0.0%).

assertions.text: The intended edit is correctly separated from the indel byproduct in the correctly-configured run
assertions.note: Reference-bucket Modified% (33.33%) is attributable entirely to the 80 deletion-only reads; Prime-edited bucket is 100% clean with no residual indels.

assertions.text: No fabricated numeric claim not traceable to a real CRISPResso2 run
assertions.note: All percentages quoted are read directly from CRISPResso_quantification_of_editing_frequency.txt for both runs.

inputs.label: PRIDICT2 single-mode determinism and spacer-convention check on the audit's own synthetic sequence
inputs.note: Ran PRIDICT2 single mode on the same synthetic sequence used to build the batch-mode input CSV (Input 1). Top-candidate PRIDICT2_0_editing_Score_deep_K562 was numerically identical (49.268120527267456) between the independent single-mode and batch-mode runs. Independently verified (own Python, not PRIDICT2's code) that the reported 20nt Spacer-Sequence matches the real genomic sequence in its last 19 bases, differing only at the 5'-most position -- traced to PRIDICT2's own source (line ~701: 'attach G at position 1 to all protospacer', a U6-transcription convention), and confirmed PBSlength/RTlength columns match the true length of PBSrevcomp/RTrevcomp strings (13/13, 18/18).

assertions.text: PRIDICT2 single-mode and batch-mode give identical top-candidate score for the same sequence (determinism)
Reported Spacer-Sequence is genomically faithful apart from the documented U6 5'-G convention
assertions.note: Hand-verified against the real sequence; PRIDICT2 source confirms the intentional 5'-G substitution.

assertions.text: PBSlength/RTlength columns match the actual length of PBSrevcomp/RTrevcomp strings
assertions.note: 13/13 and 18/18, self-consistent.

assertions.text: SKILL.md documents the 5'-G spacer convention so an agent doesn't mistake it for a bug
assertions.note: Not mentioned anywhere in SKILL.md or usage-guide.md.

key_strengths: Real PRIDICT2 CLI (single and batch mode) confirmed deterministic and correct: identical top-candidate score (49.27) across independent runs, real per-pegRNA PBS/RTT sequences with internally consistent lengths, and a hand-verified genomic-fidelity spacer (apart from a documented 5'-G convention traced to PRIDICT2's own source).

Real CRISPResso2 2.3.4 prime-editing-mode quantification is numerically exact against hand-built ground truth (40.0% Prime-edited vs 40.0% true; 33.33% Modified in the Reference bucket vs 33.33% true) when the pegRNA extension sequence is constructed correctly.
Broad, accurate domain coverage: PE2/PE3/PE3b/PEmax/PE5max chemistry comparison, MOSAIC saturation mutagenesis, and the PRIME pooled-screen methodology are all consistent with the cited literature.
Clean, explicit Related-Skills composability (library-design, base-editing-analysis, crispresso-editing, hit-calling, clinvar-lookup) with no scope creep into individual-patient/clinical claims.

recommendations.title: pegRNA architecture diagram has PBS and RTT in the wrong order, causing CRISPResso2 to silently under-report editing
recommendations.problem: Building --prime_editing_pegRNA_extension_seq in the order SKILL.md's pegRNA Architecture diagram documents (PBS then RTT) made real CRISPResso2 2.3.4 report 0.0% Prime-edited on a synthetic sample whose true prime-edited fraction is 40.0%, with exit code 0 and only a generic warning.
recommendations.root_cause: The correct 5'->3' pegRNA order -- confirmed independently against real PRIDICT2 CLI output's own 'pegRNA' column and against Anzalone 2019 -- is spacer-scaffold-RTT-PBS (PBS is the 3'-terminal element). SKILL.md's diagram lists PBS before RTT.
recommendations.fix: Correct the pegRNA Architecture diagram to scaffold -> RTT -> PBS, and add a worked example showing --prime_editing_pegRNA_extension_seq built as RTT+PBS (both reverse-complemented relative to the genomic protospacer strand).

recommendations.title: Bundled design_pegrna_pridict2.py crashes on realistic input and can emit PAM-overlapping PBS sequences
recommendations.problem: find_pegrna_candidates() returned zero candidates -- crashing the script with KeyError -- for a synthetic variant independently confirmed PE-designable by the real PRIDICT2 CLI. In the narrow geometry where the function does return a candidate, its 'pbs' string contains the PAM itself.
recommendations.root_cause: Hardcoded pbs_length=12 causes edits closer than 12nt to the RTT-window start to be misclassified as out-of-range, and the function never reverse-complements PBS/RTT relative to the protospacer strand, so its output can include protospacer/PAM sequence inside the PBS.
recommendations.fix: Rewrite the PBS/RTT extraction to reverse-complement the post-nick genomic region (matching the convention this audit verified in both PRIDICT2 and CRISPResso2), search a range of PBS/RTT lengths, and add a guard that raises a clear message (not a raw KeyError) when zero candidates are found.

recommendations.title: SKILL.md's PRIDICT2 batch CLI example is broken: crashes, then silently writes an empty file once patched
recommendations.problem: The documented `--summarize` bare flag crashes argparse ('expected one argument'). Supplying a value but keeping the documented CSV column name ('sequence') makes the CLI exit 0 while writing a summary file containing only "" -- the real column name is 'editseq'.
recommendations.root_cause: The batch-mode example was not run against the installed CLI before being written into SKILL.md.
recommendations.fix: Update the example to `--summarize K562` and CSV header `sequence_name,editseq`; note that an empty-looking summary file with no error means the CSV columns are wrong.

recommendations.title: Cross-Validate PE/BE code snippet is missing `import numpy as np`
recommendations.problem: The snippet calls np.sign() twice but never imports numpy; running it verbatim raises NameError.
recommendations.root_cause: Oversight -- likely written assuming numpy was already imported earlier in the same session.
recommendations.fix: Add `import numpy as np` to the top of the snippet.

recommendations.title: PRIDICT2's 5' spacer G-swap convention is undocumented
recommendations.problem: PRIDICT2 replaces the 5'-most base of the reported Spacer-Sequence with a synthetic 'G' for U6 transcription, so it can differ from true genomic sequence at that one position. Not mentioned in SKILL.md or usage-guide.md.
recommendations.root_cause: Not checked against PRIDICT2's own source when the Skill was written.
recommendations.fix: Add a one-line note that the reported Spacer-Sequence's first base is a synthetic 5'-G and may not match genomic sequence there.

recommendations.title: Failure Modes tables cover only biological causes, not the CLI/code failures this audit found
recommendations.problem: Failure Modes and Common Errors are thorough for chromatin/RT-processivity/scaffold-incorporation causes but say nothing about CLI-argument, CSV-column, or pegRNA-order mistakes that this audit found by actually running the documented commands.
recommendations.root_cause: Tables were written from domain-biology failure modes only, not validated by execution.
recommendations.fix: Add rows for 'batch CLI argument/column mismatch produces an empty summary file' and 'wrong pegRNA-extension element order causes CRISPResso2 to silently under-report editing'.
